CODEX_POOLER_TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generated independent 32-character key for operator two-factor secrets. Preserve and back it up with the database.

CODEX_POOLER_TOTP_KEY_VERSION.description: Encryption key version label. Keep v1; changing the label alone does not rotate stored secrets.

CODEX_POOLER_UPSTREAM_SECRET_KEY.description: Generated independent 32-character key for stored upstream credentials. Preserve and back it up with the database.

CODEX_POOLER_UPSTREAM_SECRET_KEY_VERSION.description: Upstream encryption key version label. Keep v1 unless following an explicit key-rotation procedure.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private connection to the included Postgres service. References resolve automatically; keep the database private.

OBAN_MODE.description: Keep all: runs web requests, background jobs and scheduled tasks in this single application service.

PHX_HOST.description: Generated public hostname. For a custom domain, replace this with that hostname without https:// or a path.

PHX_SERVER.description: Keep true to start the HTTP server. The pre-deploy migration command disables it only for its own process.

POOL_SIZE.description: Database connections per application replica. Keep 10 for the default single-replica deployment.

PORT.description: Application port. Keep 4000 to match the public domain and readiness check.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Keep 135 seconds to allow the app to drain active requests and finish background-job shutdown.

SECRET_KEY_BASE.description: Generated 64-character session secret. Preserve it across redeployments and keep a secure backup.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database created on first startup. Keep codex_pooler; changing this later does not rename an existing database.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Generated independent database password. Preserve it across redeployments; changing a variable alone does not rotate the stored database role password.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Database owner created on first startup. Keep codex_pooler; the application references this automatically.
